course_name_original: Mecanica ruperii si deformarii plastice - PROIECT
course_name_en: Fracture and Plastic Deformation Mechanics - PROJECT

learning_outcomes.text: Introduction of notions of structural integrity and durability with defects and cracks, definition of fracture mechanics parameters, application of fracture mechanics criteria.

Analytical, numerical (using specialized software) and experimental determination of fracture mechanics parameters, familiarization with national and international standards for determining fracture toughness.

syllabus_topics: Introduction, specific elements of fracture mechanics
Linear-elastic fracture mechanics. Griffith theory. Westergaard solution. Irwin approximation. Definition of stress intensity factor
Stress intensity factor for bodies with different types of cracks
Aspects of finite element modeling of cracked bodies. Creating crack tip singularity. Methods for estimating fracture mechanics parameters
Experimental methods for determining the stress intensity factor
Experimental determination of fracture toughness. Influence factors of fracture toughness
Aspects of elasto-plastic fracture mechanics. Size of the plastic zone formed at the crack tip. Crack tip opening displacement. J-integral
Analytical calculation of fracture mechanics parameters in the linear-elastic domain
Calculation of crack propagation rate and durability of structural elements
Experimental determination of fracture toughness. KIC method
Determination of stress intensity factor at a crack tip by photoelasticity
Determination of crack propagation rate under variable loading
Determination of fracture mechanics parameters by Finite Element Method
Estimation of durability of structural elements based on fracture mechanics principles

assessment_methods.method: Written exam (2 theory topics and 1 application)
Short project (Finite Element Method determination of stress intensity factors) completed during lab hours

assessment_rules: Knowledge of linear-elastic and elasto-plastic fracture mechanics parameters; understanding and applying criteria for fracture of cracked parts; performing numerical simulations to determine fracture mechanics parameters are required for passing.
